subject: EU edge partition — temporary reroute & next steps
messages:
From: FarmFresh Ops <ops@farmfresh.co>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: SRE Lead <sre-lead@farmfresh.co>
Date: 2029-11-05T02:15:00Z
Subject: 503 spikes from EU region — immediate impact

Hi Mina,

We started seeing a spike in 503/timeout errors from the EU endpoints around 02:05 UTC (approx). Errors affect our checkout chat assistant and a small ML batch job. Region looks like eu-west-1. Retries are causing user-facing latency > 8s. Can you confirm if there is an ongoing outage on Redwood's side?

We’ve rolled back a config change on our side (no deploys in the last 6 hours) and still see failures. Attaching a short sample request/response and error logs.

Sample: attachment: farmfresh_eu_errors.log (txt)

Can you advise immediate mitigation steps? We can temporarily route traffic to another region if you provide instructions.

Thanks,
Sam Patel
Ops Manager — FarmFresh Foods
ops@farmfresh.co
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: FarmFresh Ops <ops@farmfresh.co>
Cc: SRE Lead <sre-lead@farmfresh.co>
Date: 2029-11-05T02:32:10Z
Subject: Re: 503 spikes from EU region — immediate impact

Hi Sam — thanks for the report and the logs. We see elevated error rates from our eu-edge fabric (internal incident INC-4521). Immediate mitigation options you can take while we stabilize: 

1) Region override (recommended short-term): add header X-Redwood-Prefer-Region: us to force calls to our US serving pool. This requires no code change if you can inject a request header at your API gateway.

2) Fallback hostname: switch your endpoint to api-us.redwood.ai (DNS change or proxy rule) — this will route to the US control plane and serving runtime.

3) SDK param: if you use the Redwood SDK, set region: "us" in the client configuration (example below).

We’re also enabling automatic fallback on our side for compatible requests; I’ll confirm once the routing rule is live.

Quick SDK snippet (node):
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, region: 'us' });

I’ve attached a short runbook with step-by-step reroute options (runbook_reroute_steps.pdf). If you want, we can toggle the reroute from our side and monitor; tell me which option you prefer.

We’ll keep you posted every 15 minutes until stable.

— Mina Haddad
Technical Account Lead, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
From: SRE Lead <sre-lead@farmfresh.co>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: FarmFresh Ops <ops@farmfresh.co>
Date: 2029-11-05T02:45:05Z
Subject: Re: 503 spikes from EU region — immediate impact

On Tue, Nov 5, 2029 at 02:32 +0000, Mina Haddad wrote:
> We’re also enabling automatic fallback on our side for compatible requests; I’ll confirm once the routing rule is live.

Thanks Mina. We can inject the header at our edge proxy (Envoy) within 10 minutes. Please go ahead and enable the automatic fallback in parallel and confirm when you see successful 200 responses from the US pool. Also, FYI we have a compliance requirement to keep EU-only PII for some flows — I’ll flag which endpoints must not cross regions (checkout-fulfillment). We will only reroute non-PII chat assistant traffic for now.

Sam
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-11-05T03:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: EU edge partition — temporary reroute & next steps

Team — forwarding FarmFresh alert. Summary: elevated 5xxs from eu-edge fabric (likely peering/egress degradation). Customer is OK with routing non-PII chat traffic to the US pool. Ask list: 

- Vanessa: enable automatic fallback routing policy for account farmfresh (match: tag:chat-assistant, exclude: checkout-fulfillment). Please monitor failover metrics (5m window) and post a short status.
- Rishi: check Dedicated and Hosted capacity in us-east & us-west for spare headroom; if capacity < 20% we should prepare burst instances.
- Lauren: notify Partnerships/CloudOps for potential peering issue with eu provider — we’ll need a bridge call if traffic spike persists.
- Marcus: prepare a short customer-safe postmortem template and schedule a 60-min postmortem at 16:00 UTC; include owners from infra and networking. I’m attaching the reroute runbook.

We should keep the customer updated every 15 minutes until we stabilize. I’ll enable the fallback rule after Vanessa confirms config on our side.

— Mina
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: FarmFresh Ops <ops@farmfresh.co>
Cc: SRE Lead <sre-lead@farmfresh.co>
Date: 2029-11-05T06:02:30Z
Subject: Re: 503 spikes from EU region — temporary reroute & next steps

Hi Sam — quick update and confirmed actions: 

- At 03:12 UTC we enabled automatic fallback routing for FarmFresh account (scope: tag:chat-assistant, exclude path: /checkout-fulfillment).
- You confirmed header injection at 03:18 UTC; traffic for non-PII chat requests is now routed to our US pool and 200 response rates recovered to baseline by 03:24 UTC.
- We’ve queued a postmortem (JIRA-INC-4521) and scheduled an internal RCA at 16:00 UTC (invite attached: postmortem_invite.ics).

What to expect next:
- Short-term: we recommend keeping the header override active for 24 hours. We will continuously monitor and only remove the override once the eu-edge fabric shows stable e2e success rates for 60 minutes.
- Medium-term: our networking team will investigate peering/egress anomalies and produce a customer-facing summary within 72 hours.

Regarding your on-prem/private question — if you require EU-only data residency for checkout-fulfillment, we can prepare a Private deployment or Dedicated pool in eu-west; I’ve asked Rishi to provide capacity/cost estimates.

Please confirm you’re seeing normal behavior from your side and whether you’d like Redwood to keep the header override enabled for you.

Thanks for the quick coordination — we’ll keep the updates coming.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Technical Account Lead, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
